description: This Java source file defines the AuditorAwareConfig class which implements AuditorAware interface to provide auditor information (such as user ID) for auditing purposes within a Spring Data context. It retrieves the current authenticated user's ID from the ApiRequestContextHolder and defaults to 'SYSTEM_USER' if none is available.

classes.name: AuditorAwareConfig
classes.description: A Spring component that provides the current auditor (user) ID for auditing purposes, implementing the AuditorAware interface.

methods.name: getCurrentAuditor
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the current user's ID, or 'SYSTEM_USER' if no user ID is available.
